payload.summary: Read-only recon of the LIVE tree (/opt/envs/wu1w/.../vllm, NOT the hinted /opt/envs/vllm). gfx90a => get_cdna_version()==2, so is_aiter_found_and_supported() (CDNA3+) is False and all 22 @if_aiter_supported predicates silently return None. Only is_linear_enabled()+register_ops_once() got the gfx90a is_aiter_attention_supported() carve-out, so AITER INT8 ScaledMM is live while the AITER GDN decode, MHA and unified-attn switches stay dead. Baseline log confirms: GDN decode=triton, cPA rejected (head_size 256) -> Triton paged decode, 75.4% prefix-cache hit.

proposal_set.name: gdn-aiter-decode-bridge
proposal_set.reason: Env alone is a NO-OP (already in baseline): the AITER GDN decode fast path is un-bridged on gfx90a twice over. (a) rocm_aiter_ops.are_gdn_triton_kernels_available() is @if_aiter_supported => returns None because is_aiter_found_and_supported() demands get_cdna_version()>2 and gfx90a returns 2, so GDN_AITER_TRITON_AVAILABLE=False (qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py:79) and forward() takes forward_cuda, missing the fused conv1d+recurrent-decode kernels that ARE installed in aiter 0.1.19. (b) _forward_core_rocm gates the fast path on self.gqa_interleaved_layout, hardcoded False for Qwen3.5 (qwen3_5.py:148). Patch owner: mirror the existing is_aiter_attention_supported() carve-out used by is_linear_enabled (i.e. gate on on_gfx9()), and for the layout either drop validate_data=True or call the layout-agnostic aiter kernels separately (aiter/ops/triton/causal_conv1d_decode.py + gated_delta_net/fused_rearrange_sigmoid_gdr.py) on the already-split mixed_qkv/b/a. 48 of 64 layers are GDN and the workload is 1024-in/1024-out at conc 64 (decode-dominated), so this is the highest-ceiling bridge on the box.
source_evidence: /opt/envs/wu1w/lib/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/_aiter_ops.py:195-207 if_aiter_supported returns None (falsy) when not is_aiter_found_and_supported()
/opt/envs/wu1w/lib/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/_aiter_ops.py:1832-1837 is_linear_enabled() uses the carve-out (the one bridge already landed)

proposal_set.name: decoder-attn-triton-vs-cpa-headsize
proposal_set.reason: Un-bridged-by-design-looking but silently-unreachable fast path: use_rocm_custom_paged_attention() hard-codes head_size == 64 or head_size == 128, so this model's head_dim=256 decoder falls off the tuned CDNA cPA kernel onto the generic Triton chunked_prefill_paged_decode path. The baseline log prints only 'Cannot use ROCm custom paged attention kernel, falling back to Triton implementation.' with no head_size reason, which is why it reads as a hardware limit rather than a one-constant guard. gqa_ratio here is 24Q/4KV = 6, inside cPA's 1..16 range, so head_size is the ONLY failing conjunct. No gfx90a-specific predicate is involved (the on_cdna() branch does cover CDNA2), and no source patch is needed to A/B it: if cPA hd256 is correct-but-untuned it may beat the generic Triton path; if the head_dim is genuinely load-bearing the variant crashes or loses, which is itself the answer. Cheap, reversible, zero-patch probe of the 16 full-attention layers.
source_evidence: /opt/envs/wu1w/lib/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/platforms/rocm.py:385-421 use_rocm_custom_paged_attention(): on_cdna() branch requires (head_size == 64 or head_size == 128) and 1 <= gqa_ratio <= 16
/opt/envs/wu1w/lib/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/v1/attention/ops/chunked_prefill_paged_decode.py:463 warning 'Cannot use ROCm custom paged attention kernel, falling back to Triton implementation.'
/opt/envs/wu1w/lib/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/v1/attention/backends/rocm_attn.py:446 chunked_prefill_paged_decode(...) - the fallback actually executed per decode step
baseline server.log line 61 confirms the cPA rejection at runtime; line 32 shows ROCM_ATTN selected over TRITON_ATTN
/opt/envs/wu1w/lib/python3.12/site-packages/vllm/model_executor/models/qwen3_5.py head_dim=256 family (see also model_arch.json law 11: AITER ASM FA covers hd128/hd192x128 only)

proposal_set.name: gdn-packed-recurrent-decode-ab
proposal_set.reason: Cheap env-only A/B that de-risks proposal 1 and probes the same 48-layer hot path. The switch defaults ON, routing every GDN decode step through fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule_packed_decode (3-D q/k/v + ssm_state_indices gather, built for NVIDIA Hopper wgmma per its own comment) instead of the 2-D path. On gfx90a/CDNA2 the packed 3-D indexing is a plausible pessimization rather than a win, and this is the exact kernel the AITER bridge would replace - so its sign tells the patch owner whether the GDN decode kernel choice is worth a patch at all. No capability predicate involved, so it is a pure routing A/B with a low KEEP threshold (1.0%) upside if the 2-D path schedules better on CDNA2.
source_evidence: third_party/flash_linear_attention/ops/fused_recurrent.py: 3-D qkv path commented as required for NVIDIA Hopper wgmma, 2-D otherwise

new_findings.what: The LIVE framework tree for this session is /opt/envs/wu1w/lib/python3.12/site-packages/vllm (0.28.0), reached via /usr/local/bin/vllm-wu1w -> /opt/envs/wu1w/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main. The hint-list root /opt/envs/vllm/lib/python3.12/site-packages/vllm is a DIFFERENT, unbridged copy: its _aiter_ops.py has no is_aiter_attention_supported() carve-out and is_linear_enabled is still decorated with @if_aiter_supported. Static recon against the hinted root would have concluded AITER INT8 is dead here, which is wrong.
new_findings.source: /usr/local/bin/vllm-wu1w; diff of _aiter_ops.py and qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py between the two roots
new_findings.expected_impact: Prevents false-negative 'no bridge available' conclusions and prevents patching a tree the server never imports.

new_findings.what: CDNA3 umbrella gate: is_aiter_found_and_supported() returns get_cdna_version() > 2, and get_cdna_version() returns 2 for gfx90a. The @if_aiter_supported decorator then returns None (not False, and not the real value) for 22 predicates: is_enabled, is_linear_fp8_enabled, is_fused_moe_enabled, is_fusion_moe_shared_experts_enabled, is_fused_moe_situv2_a8w4_enabled, topk_softmax_supports_fused_sigmoid, fuse_sigmoid_in_kernel, is_mla_enabled, is_mha_enabled, is_custom_all_reduce_enabled, is_shuffle_kv_cache_enabled, is_triton_unified_attn_enabled, is_fp8bmm_enabled, is_fp4bmm_enabled, is_linear_hipbmm_enabled, is_asm_fp4_gemm_dynamic_quant_enabled, is_triton_rotary_embed_enabled, is_triton_gemm_enabled, is_tgemm_enabled, are_gdn_triton_kernels_available, fused_moe_supports_gate_mode, get_moe_dispatch_policy. The class docstring claims the decorator checks is_on_gfx9(); the code does not - it requires CDNA3+.
new_findings.expected_impact: Single highest-leverage bridge on this box: one gfx9-inclusive predicate (already written as is_aiter_attention_supported()) restores the whole AITER switch family, of which only is_linear_enabled is currently wired.
new_findings.accuracy_risk: Enabling is_fused_moe_enabled / is_mla_enabled wholesale is UNSAFE here (MoE model absent, and per-box law: AITER fused-MoE is dead on gfx90a). A bridge must be per-predicate, not a blanket change to is_aiter_found_and_supported().

new_findings.what: The AITER GDN decode fast path is doubly blocked for Qwen3.5: GDN_AITER_TRITON_AVAILABLE is False on gfx90a because are_gdn_triton_kernels_available() sits under the CDNA3 umbrella, and even when True, _forward_core_rocm only dispatches to _forward_core_decode_aiter when self.gqa_interleaved_layout is True, which qwen3_5.py hardcodes to False. The comment states the fused aiter reshape/conv kernel expects Qwen3-Next's interleaved GQA layout; aiter 0.1.19 does ship layout-agnostic causal_conv1d_decode.py and gated_delta_net/fused_rearrange_sigmoid_gdr.py, so the block is a layout-contract issue, not missing hardware support.
new_findings.expected_impact: 48 of 64 layers are GDN and the workload is decode-dominated (conc 64, OSL 1024); a fused conv1d+delta-rule decode replaces several Triton launches per layer per step.
new_findings.accuracy_risk: Must reproduce the interleaved->split layout remap exactly; validate_data=True in the aiter kernel is the guard that would catch a wrong remap. Keep the accuracy gate on.

new_findings.what: Full-attention decode does not use a hand-tuned kernel on this model: use_rocm_custom_paged_attention() requires head_size in {64,128}, head_dim here is 256, so ROCM_ATTN falls back to Triton chunked_prefill_paged_decode with a warning that omits the reason. gqa_ratio 6 is inside the supported 1..16 window, so head_size is the sole failing conjunct, and the on_cdna() branch does include CDNA2 - this is not a gfx90a capability gate.
new_findings.expected_impact: Affects the 16 full-attention layers only; modest ceiling but zero-patch testable via --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN.
new_findings.accuracy_risk: Low for the A/B; a cPA hd256 source bridge would need numerical validation (cPA had a documented sliding-window discrepancy history).

new_findings.what: Fused CUDA/hip GDN decode is genuinely absent, not merely gated: the live tree already carries a gfx90a-shaped bridge (import fused_gdn_hip + hasattr(torch.ops.fused_gdn_hip,'fused_gdn_decode_post_conv_mtp') checks at qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py:13, 538, 1819 and _custom_ops.py:2798), but neither the module nor the symbol exists (0 hits in vllm/_C.abi3.so), so VLLM_GDN_DECODE_KERNEL=cuda (the default) logs 'is not built' and self-selects triton. Note the guard also requires head_k_dim==head_v_dim==128 (satisfied) and bf16 conv state, and it hard-raises if VLLM_GDN_DECODE_KERNEL is set explicitly.
new_findings.expected_impact: Redirects the GDN decode effort away from a CUDA-op build toward the AITER Triton path; also means the shipped default for VLLM_GDN_DECODE_KERNEL is misleading on this box.
new_findings.accuracy_risk: Do NOT set VLLM_GDN_DECODE_KERNEL=cuda as a variant - with the var explicitly in os.environ the code raises ValueError instead of falling back, which would fail the launch.

new_findings.what: Baseline runtime dispatch facts: AiterInt8ScaledMMLinearKernel IS selected for CompressedTensorsW8A8Int8 (proves the is_linear_enabled gfx90a carve-out is live and working); rms_norm IR priority is ['aiter','native']; enable_prefix_caching=True with 75.4% hit rate and Mamba cache mode 'align'; ROCM_ATTN auto-selected (only TURBOQUANT rejected); 294,473-token KV pool at 47.93x concurrency for 6144 tokens, KV usage 38-48% so no preemption pressure at conc 64.
new_findings.expected_impact: Scopes the remaining headroom to GDN decode and the hd256 attention kernel - the INT8 GEMM dispatch is already on the fast path, so further GEMM-backend proposals would be redundant.

new_findings.what: AITER's own attention stack is present but unreachable on this box because of the same CDNA3 umbrella: is_mha_enabled(), is_triton_unified_attn_enabled() and is_shuffle_kv_cache_enabled() all return None on gfx90a, and rocm_aiter_fa.py:784 independently returns get_cdna_version() > 2. Per-box law 11 (head_dim=256 vs ASM FA hd128/192) means ROCM_AITER_FA is still the wrong target, but VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTENTION=1 (default False) is blocked by is_triton_unified_attn_enabled() returning None, so the env is inert until the predicate is bridged - it is not a no-op because of a hardware limit.
new_findings.expected_impact: Explains why env-only AITER proposals fail silently; a unified-attention bridge is a second-order candidate behind the GDN one.
new_findings.accuracy_risk: Triton unified attention may be slower than chunked_prefill_paged_decode at hd256 on CDNA2 - do not propose the env without the predicate bridge.
